defect: the terminal revoke was a deferred action sequenced before RemoveFiles, which is still after Windows Installer removes the product registration
mechanism: InstallInitialize (1500) writes the removal script that unregisters the product and deletes component registry values
a deferred custom action cannot run before InstallInitialize, so the revoke at 3499 always executed after the registration was gone
rollback restored files but not the registration, leaving an installed directory with no ARP entry that the user could not repair

fix.change: Execute=deferred -> immediate, and sequence Before=RemoveFiles -> After=InstallValidate
fix.rationale: an immediate action between InstallValidate (1400) and InstallInitialize (1500) aborts the sequence before any removal script runs

caveats: the clean uninstall that followed left 9 of 11 files because the component registration had already been removed by the earlier attempt; that leftover state is a consequence of the pre-fix run in the same session, not of the new ordering
